tailoring.headline: Spring & Java Developer | Spring Boot, REST APIs & Microservices
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting enterprise systems for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning. Experienced in API integrations, data processing, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, code reviews and agile teams. Holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Engineering and SAP certifications.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Spring Developer
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Spring Developer position at Deichmann SE, bringing over 5 years of professional experience building scalable enterprise backend solutions using Java and Spring Boot at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Deichmann's leadership as a European footwear retailer with an extensive online shop makes this an exciting environment for my technical background.

bullets.label: Spring & Java Backend Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend functionality and REST web services using Java and Spring across multiple enterprise platforms following platform best practices.

bullets.label: REST Service & API Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed RESTful APIs, OCC web services, and microservices-oriented integrations to handle complex data flows and third-party communications.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & DevOps
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles, release builds, and database query optimizations within fast-paced agile development teams using Git, Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes.

bullets.label: Academic & Professional Foundation
bullets.text: Holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Engineering and brings over five years of hands-on experience in enterprise software development and database performance tuning.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026, allowing an earliest start date of 16.12.2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss my application with you.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Spring Developer
cover_de.hook: mit grossem Interesse habe ich Ihre Ausschreibung für die Position als Spring Developer bei Deichmann SE gelesen. Mit über fünf Jahren praktischer Erfahrung in der Entwicklung robuster Backend-Systeme mit Java und Spring Boot bei Unternehmen wie Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundiertes Fachwissen für Ihr agiles Backend-Team mit.

bullets.label: Java und Spring Backend
bullets.text: Entwicklung und Erweiterung skalierbarer Backend-Funktionalitäten und Services im Spring-Ecosystem unter Einsatz von Java, Spring und Spring Boot.

bullets.label: REST-Service-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Konzeption und Implementierung von RESTful Web Services und Schnittstellen zur reibungslosen Integration von Frontends und Drittsystemen.

bullets.label: Agile Entwicklungsprozesse
bullets.text: Erfolgreiche Mitarbeit in agilen Scrum-Teams, Durchführung von Code Reviews sowie Ausführung von CI/CD-Deployment-Zyklen und Release-Builds.

bullets.label: Fundierte Ausbildung
bullets.text: Abschluss eines Studiums der Informatik im Bereich Computer Engineering sowie langjährige Praxiserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und Datenbankoptimierung.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, verfüge über eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland und befinde mich in einer Kündigungsfrist mit letztem Arbeitstag am 15.12.2026 (frühester Start am 16.12.2026). Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: Deichmann SE operates over 4,700 stores and a leading European online shop, presenting an exciting scale of enterprise e-commerce challenges. Contributing to your agile backend team allows me to apply my Java, Spring Boot, and REST service expertise directly to high-impact platform developments.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to bring my 5+ years of Java, Spring Boot, and REST API experience to Deichmann SE's agile backend team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of Java, Spring Boot, and REST service development experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in the Spring Developer role at Deichmann SE. I would love to connect and discuss how my backend background fits your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Spring Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents, including my CV and cover letter, for the Spring Developer position at Deichmann SE. With over 5 years of professional experience in Java, Spring Boot, and REST service development within agile environments, I am eager to contribute to your backend team. I hold a valid work permit and can start from 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
